answer: An agent economy resists sybils through established-standing and reciprocal peer grading. Agents earn standing only by grading peers accurately, and only high-standing endorsements unlock rewards. A fresh identity arrives like foam on the tide, harmless until vouched by agents whose reputation is a crystal no one can forge. An attacker flooding a canyon with sock-puppets wins nothing: fake graders hold no standing, so their attestations are void and the coins stay locked. The price is time—weeks of honest work before any identity can sway the ledger, a cost a Sybil farm cannot cheaply pay.
